items.docs: Returns a paginated list of credentialing workflows for the organization.

Creates a new note associated with the specified credentialing workflow.

      ### Functionality
      - Adds a user-generated note to a credentialing workflow.
      - Useful for internal communication, tracking decisions, or annotating the process.
      - The note will be associated with the given workflow ID.
Updates an existing note associated with a credentialing workflow.

info.name: Populate template fields for credentialing workflow

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the credentialing workflow for which to populate template fields.

params.name: reasons
params.description: A comma-separated list of reasons to be included in the template fields (e.g., "reason1,reason2"). These reasons should already be present in the organization settings under "outreach" to be used here.

items.docs: Retrieves and populates template fields for the specified credentialing workflow. Useful for generating documents, emails, or other communications that require workflow-specific data to be inserted into templates.
